options.content:
**Cohort** covers PRs merged in the selected time range. Release lines come from the target branch. With Pipeline set to All, the ratios use PR-Changes.

**Single-pass ratio** counts one successful execution with no observed rerun per assessable PR. **No observed rerun ratio** counts assessable PRs without a same-revision rerun. **Evidence coverage** is the assessable share of merged PRs. PRs without observed validation remain in the coverage denominator because policy applicability is unknown.

Equal build commits under the same pipeline definition and recorded task retries provide rerun evidence. Distinct merge commits alone leave the source and target changes ambiguous. An unlinked PR-Package run leaves the full chain unassessable, even when a validation succeeded.

panels.title: Ratios, reruns and evidence coverage

panels.description: PRs merged (Closed) inside the selected range, grouped by target release branch prefix. Organization and Project apply; Pipeline All defaults to PR-Changes. Retained run history before merge is used, not just runs in the merge window. Distinct BuildId re-executions require the same pipeline definition, PR iteration and commit; Attempt > 1 counts an in-build retry. A new iteration AND new commit marks a changed revision, not a rerun. Missing metadata, missing attempt evidence, conflicting revision signals or PRs predating retained history remain insufficient. All metrics describe observed history; deleted runs and uncollected automatic task retries may be invisible. No vendor cause inferred. Stacked percentages use all merged PRs as denominator. Categories are exclusive; insufficient evidence takes precedence. Verified 10 Nov 2026 YAML changes: PR 5681 merged into release/2.61/development at 17:31:37 UTC; PR 5678 into development at 17:33:16 UTC. PR-Changes previously waited for PR-Package; now uses FindChanges and conditional BuildChanges. Expected stage skips and absent PR-Package are not missing evidence. Merge times do not prove per-run YAML adoption. PRs with recorded runs but conflicting iteration/commit transitions are a separate ambiguous-revision category, excluded from assessable denominators. Explicit ParentBuildId links attach PR-Package to PR-Changes without counting the child as another validation. Linked child attempt >1 or multiple child builds counts as a chain rerun. Unlinked children are shown separately; no temporal matching. Audited build merge commits are normalized to verified PR-source and target parents. Same source with a changed target is a target refresh, not a same-input rerun. Evidence map covers 460 audited commits across 153 PR histories; unreviewed conflicts remain ambiguous.

ADOTelemetry.PipelineStep?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and Started lt ${__to:date:iso})/groupby((Organization,Project,BuildId),aggregate(Attempt with max as MaxAttempt,RecordId with countdistinct as ObservedRecords))&$top=20000

ADOTelemetry.PipelineRun?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and Pipeline eq 'PR-Package' and Started lt ${__to:date:iso})/groupby((Organization,Project,BuildId,ParentBuildId,PullRequestId,Result,Started,Finished))&$top=20000

panels.title: Merged PRs by validation path — missing evidence separate

Retained run history before merge is used, not just runs in the merge window. Distinct BuildId re-executions require the same pipeline definition, PR iteration and commit; Attempt > 1 counts an in-build retry. A new iteration AND new commit marks a changed revision, not a rerun. Missing metadata, missing attempt evidence, conflicting revision signals or PRs predating retained history remain insufficient. All metrics describe observed history; deleted runs and uncollected automatic task retries may be invisible. No vendor cause inferred. Single-pass numerator requires exactly one successful selected run and no retry. No-rerun numerator allows changed revisions. Both exclude insufficient PRs from denominator; coverage shows the excluded share. Zero assessable PRs yields unknown, never zero percent. Explicit ParentBuildId links attach PR-Package to PR-Changes without counting the child as another validation. Linked child attempt >1 or multiple child builds counts as a chain rerun. Unlinked children are shown separately; no temporal matching. Audited build merge commits are normalized to verified PR-source and target parents. Same source with a changed target is a target refresh, not a same-input rerun. Evidence map covers 460 audited commits across 153 PR histories; unreviewed conflicts remain ambiguous.
